spec.title: Provenance — schema-evolution discovery, imported 2026-08-09
spec.p: This directory is a byte-for-byte import of `C:\Users\olegc\git\v\discovery\vibevm-schema-evolution-discovery\` (the original stays in place; pointers in `CONTINUE.md`, `spec/WAL.xml` and `BACKLOG.md ##owner-decisions` refer to it). Imported so the study obeys the project's own law — files inside the repository are the only shared memory — after the owner flagged the out-of-tree location as a fragility.

**Genre: research documents (comparative-research flow).** Non-binding. The study speaks in dated verbatim quotes; `02-primary-sources-cache/` holds the third-party primary sources it cites (same posture as `refs/` — reference copies, not authored content, not relicensable). Reading order and the mandatory-reading list live in `12-HANDOFF.xml §2`.

list.item: Contract: [`spec/common/PROP-044-change-native-formats.xml`](../../common/PROP-044-change-native-formats.xml) — the change-native formats ideology this study fed.
Lore: [`spec/design/change-native-formats-verdict.xml`](../../design/change-native-formats-verdict.xml) — the convened-council verdict that chose the architecture, recorded in full.
Plan: the change-native build campaign this study fed (TZ v0.1) — executed whole and folded into its tombstone 2026-08-18; a closed plan is cited by name and date, never path-linked (the B-088 law).

spec.p: This subtree is deliberately **outside the progress-markup corpus** (`progress.toml` includes are enumerated and do not name `spec/research/**`): these are evidence documents, not contracts — per the campaign's own line, a document enters the corpus when it asserts something this project could be wrong about *as a claim of its own*; a study's claims are claims about others, kept with their quotes and re-fetch lists instead of verdicts.
